item.title: Keeping It Safe: The PPE Manager
item.description: Why do we need a PPE manager? Our PPE protects every fire department’s most valuable assets—its firefighters. As a result, our PPE selection and maintenance have become a key component of any well-run department and require a dedicated role. The post Keeping It Safe: The PPE Manager appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: Ladder Truck Lifts Boy to See His Firefighter Father Through Hospital Window
